name: DatePicker
intent: A date field that opens a calendar to pick one date, or a range between two dates. Looks like Input.
usage: Use DatePicker for dates in forms and filters. mode single picks one day; mode range picks a start and an end across two months, with quick ranges like Last week. Picks stay pending until Apply; Cancel, Escape or a click outside leave the value as it was. Dates are ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD); a range is { start, end }. Label, hint, error, help and sizes work like Input. See contracts/datepicker.json for the full contract.

label.note: Always set. With hideLabel it stays for screen readers only.

mode.note: range shows two months, quick ranges and the picked range in the footer.

size.note: Field height 28 / 36 / 44, same as Input. The calendar has one size.

placeholder.note: Defaults to Select date, or Select dates in range mode.

value.note: Controlled. YYYY-MM-DD, or { start, end } in range mode.

minDate.note: YYYY-MM-DD. Earlier days cannot be picked.

maxDate.note: YYYY-MM-DD. Later days cannot be picked.

presets.note: Range mode only: Today, Yesterday, This week, Last week, This month, Last month, This year, Last year.

name.note: Hidden input for forms. Range submits start/end, like 2027-01-08/2027-01-14.

error.note: Message under the field. Also turns the border red.

help.note: Help icon beside the label. The text shows in a HelpPopover titled with the label, on hover, keyboard focus or click.

useWhen: A date in a form, like an invoice or due date.
A period for a report or filter, like last month (mode range).
doNot: Do not invent a local Calendar, DateRangePicker, Popover or native input type=date.
Do not use two DatePickers for a start and end. Use mode range.
Do not use for time. There is no time picker yet.
a11y: The field is a button with aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded, labelled by the label. Required is read from the label; error and hint are linked with aria-describedby.
The calendar is a dialog; each month is a grid named by its heading; days are buttons named like Friday, January 8, 2027, today, start of range.
Opening moves focus to the picked day or today. Arrow keys move by day and week, Home and End to the week edges, Page Up and Page Down by month. Enter or Space picks.
Tab stays inside the calendar. Escape and Cancel close and return focus to the field; a click outside cancels.
Days outside the month are hidden from screen readers. The picked range in the footer is announced politely.

examples.usage: Pick one day. Today jumps to the current date; Apply saves.

examples.usage: Pick a start and an end across two months, or a quick range.
